verses.text: This is what the LORD said: "Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take some of the elders of the people and some of the leading priests with you,
and go out to the Valley of Ben Hinnom, near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate. Announce there the words I tell you.

Say, 'Listen to the word of the LORD, you kings of Judah and people of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Look, I am going to bring such a disaster on this place that the ears of everyone who hears about it will ring.

For they have left me and turned this place into a place for foreign gods. They have burned incense here to gods that neither they nor their ancestors nor the kings of Judah ever knew, and they have filled this place with the blood of innocent people.
They have built high places for Baal to burn their children in the fire as offerings to Baal. I never commanded this or spoke of it, and it never even entered my mind.
So look, the days are coming, says the LORD, when people will no longer call this place Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.

In this place I will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies, at the hands of those who want to kill them. I will give their dead bodies as food to the birds of the sky and the wild animals.
I will make this city a horror and something people hiss at. All who pass by will be shocked and will hiss because of all its wounds.
I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they will eat each other's flesh, during the terrible siege when their enemies who want to kill them surround them.'
Then break the jar while the men who went with you are watching,

and say to them, 'This is what the LORD of Armies says: I will smash this nation and this city just as this potter's jar is smashed, so that it cannot be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.
This is what I will do to this place and to the people who live here, says the LORD. I will make this city like Topheth.

The houses of Jerusalem and the palaces of the kings of Judah will be made unclean like Topheth, all the houses where they burned incense on the roofs to all the stars of the sky and poured out drink offerings to other gods.'"
Then Jeremiah came back from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy. He stood in the courtyard of the LORD's house and said to all the people,

"This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: 'Look, I am going to bring on this city and all the towns around it every disaster I announced against them, because they were stubborn and refused to listen to my words.'"
